title: Build Chat Interface Using assistant-ui
description: Transform the dashboard page into a real-time chat interface using assistant-ui and @ai-sdk/react hooks
details: Refactor `app/dashboard/page.tsx` to implement the main chat screen using `assistant-ui` components and `useAssistant` hook from `@ai-sdk/react`. Create a responsive chat UI with message bubbles, typing indicators, and streaming response handling. Implement auto-scroll to latest messages, message timestamps, and loading states. Add input validation and character limits. Style using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for consistency. Include error handling for failed AI requests.
test_strategy: Test chat interface responsiveness and streaming updates. Verify message history persistence and real-time updates. Test error states and loading indicators. Ensure accessibility compliance for keyboard navigation.

title: Create Calendar Dashboard with Event Visualization
description: Build a calendar view page that displays user events and provides navigation between chat and calendar views
details: Create `app/dashboard/calendar/page.tsx` using the existing `components/ui/calendar.tsx` or integrate `react-big-calendar`. Fetch user events from database using Server Actions or API routes. Implement daily, weekly, and monthly view toggles. Add event creation, editing, and deletion capabilities directly in the calendar. Create navigation between chat and calendar views in the dashboard layout. Style events with different colors based on categories. Ensure timezone handling for event display.
test_strategy: Test calendar rendering with various event densities. Verify event CRUD operations from calendar interface. Test view switching (daily/weekly/monthly) and navigation. Validate timezone handling and date calculations.

title: Add Time Analytics and Metrics Dashboard
description: Implement analytics cards showing time distribution, productivity metrics, and AI-powered insights
details: Create reusable metric card components using shadcn/ui Card component. Calculate and display: total hours per day/week, time distribution by category, productivity trends, and schedule density. Add charts using a lightweight library like Recharts for visual representation. Implement AI-powered insights by analyzing user's schedule patterns and providing recommendations through the chat interface. Create summary views for different time periods (daily, weekly, monthly). Store calculated metrics for performance optimization.
test_strategy: Test metric calculations with various schedule scenarios. Verify chart rendering and data accuracy. Test AI insight generation and recommendation quality. Validate performance with large datasets and ensure proper caching.

title: Create Database Schema for Events and Chat Messages
description: Design and implement Drizzle ORM schemas for storing schedule events and chat messages with proper relationships to users
details: Create new tables in the database schema: 1) `events` table with fields: id, userId (foreign key), title, description, startTime, endTime, category, createdAt, updatedAt. 2) `chat_messages` table with fields: id, userId (foreign key), role (user/assistant), content, timestamp, metadata (JSON for storing structured data). Ensure proper indexing on userId and timestamp fields. Create and run database migrations using Drizzle's migration system. Add Zod validation schemas for type safety.
test_strategy: Write unit tests for schema validation using Zod. Test database operations (create, read, update, delete) for both tables. Verify foreign key constraints and data integrity.

title: Implement AI Chat API Route with Streaming
description: Create the backend API endpoint that handles AI conversations and extracts structured event data using Vercel AI SDK
details: Build `/api/chat/route.ts` using Vercel AI SDK's `streamText` function with GPT-4o. Implement system prompt for time management coaching and event extraction. Use AI function calling/tools to allow the AI to create, update, and delete schedule events in the database. Handle streaming responses and error cases. Include context from recent chat history and existing user events. Implement rate limiting and input validation. Store all chat messages in the database for context and history.
test_strategy: Mock AI responses to test parsing logic. Test API endpoint with various natural language inputs. Verify event extraction accuracy and database operations. Test streaming response handling and error scenarios.
